fullDaySay:
Travel 2 tiles to wetland.
— Still water, cattails —
Reeds taller than you. The wind makes them talk to each other, and you are not part of the conversation.
Something moves out there — a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something.
You catch fragments by the fire — Tao telling A man, maybe 30s, with a crooked nose about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Mushrooms thumb up through the duff in a ring — a fairy ring, old as the path. You step around it, not through it. Some rules are older than knowledge.
It followed you. The raccoon with too many fingers is here.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
A kingfisher works the far bank, patient as a tax collector. It catches something silver and is gone before you can envy it properly.
Movement — a small fish flashing in the water.
👁 One splash and it's gone. Corner it away from the water.
✅ You saw the creek. Nora nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You clear the rubble, stone by stone. The path is clear.
You pocket 3 good throwing stones. (sling ammo)
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
Travel 1 tile to wetland.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Where the creek spreads out, the starch grows.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown shoots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to creek.
It followed you. The raccoon with too many fingers is here.
You make a Stone knife. flint knapped to an edge, bound with vine. cuts meat, wood, cord.
It sits up on its hind legs, hands moving too fast to follow. It's trying to figure out your pack.
"Dakota," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Dakota." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Dakota).
